risks.risk: Wrong fitment / mixed engines (parts may not belong to the specific RX350/ES350/IS250/Camry models claimed).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of engine/part identification tags or stamped engine codes (e.g., engine block code/serial) and part numbers on each major component, plus a sorted inventory list by engine code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as assorted used engine parts with unknown compatibility (worst-case: mixed/mismatched and sold for parts only).

risks.risk: Condition unknown: internal damage (cracks, scoring, corrosion) not visible from the container overview.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of cylinder head combustion surfaces, block deck surface, and any visible cracks; plus photos of machined surfaces and corrosion inside ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/untested parts (worst-case: may be scrap/needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Not complete sets (missing components like ECU, sensors, wiring harness, starter, alternator, timing components).
risks.proof: A full inventory/manifest with quantities of each component type, and photos showing included accessories (ECU/sensors/harness/starter/alternator) with part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/assorted components (worst-case: missing key parts).

risks.risk: “Working” claim not supported: no functional test evidence; parts may be removed from non-running engines.
risks.proof: Video of a run test (cold start) or documented compression/leak-down results for the specific engines/assemblies included.

risks.risk: Corrosion and transport damage due to rusted container and handling.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of corrosion severity on critical surfaces (bearing journals, coolant/oil passages, gasket surfaces) and any dents/impacts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as heavily used with possible corrosion/impact damage (worst-case: reduced usability).

risks.risk: Potential scam/overclaim: seller may be listing popular models to raise value while the contents are generic assorted parts.
risks.proof: Match each major component to the claimed model via engine codes/part numbers and provide a consistent inventory that aligns with RX350/ES350/IS250/Camry.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest category for generic assorted engine parts (worst-case: not matching claims).

proof_requests: Provide a sorted inventory list with quantities and exact part numbers/engine codes for each major component (cylinder heads, blocks, alternators, manifolds, etc.).
Send close-up photos of stamped engine codes/serials on the engine blocks and/or heads, and part-number labels on alternators/starter/ECU/sensors (if included).
Show photos of gasket/mating surfaces and any visible cracks, scoring, or corrosion inside ports.
Provide evidence of testing: compression/leak-down sheets or run-test video/audio for the specific assemblies included.
Confirm completeness: list what is included/excluded (ECU, sensors, wiring harness, starter, alternator condition, timing components).
Provide shipping/origin proof for “direct from Belgium” (documents or labels).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as assorted used car engine parts in a rusted container, so a worst-case price category is possible. The seller’s model/origin/testing claims are not verifiable from the witness report, so it should be priced as untested, mixed, potentially incomplete parts.
